newsitem.title: USA: NuCo2 names Joann Sabatino CFO.
newsitem.headline: NuCo2 names Joann Sabatino CFO.

text.p: NuCo2 Inc said it named Joann Sabatino chief financial officer effective October 15.
She was a partner at the company's independent auditors, Cooper, Selvin & Strassberg LLP and had over 10 years experience with clients in the beverage industry, the company said in a statement.
NuCo2 said the CFO position had been vacant for several months.
The company is the largest company the industry that supplies bulk carbon dioxide systems and liquid carbon dioxide for use in the carbonation and dispensing of fountain drinks.
